DO NOT SPEND YOUR MONEY ON THIS GAME!
So right off the bat, I will say the game 'can' be fun to play.
But here are my issues with it as the game suffers from the same mindless gacha greed as every other money hungry company in the world. I went ahead and spent $24 on the game's biggest "Vault box" I wanted to take one for the team to see how well it works. 

And about as much as you'd expect its a total rip off. The game even promises you a rare item for every 10 purchases but fails to explain that ICONS for your profile picture are also rare items. I didn't spend $24 to buy an icon. 
I also received MULTIPLES of the same item which get converted into a currency you can't even use on the same box or at all because it gives you so little back. And I will stress again that I got MULTIPLE of these duplicated items.
This essentially means you could spend hundreds of dollars and NEVER get the one thing you are actually aiming for.

 I don't think I got anything even usable in the game except for a single skin on the one character I'm sure nobody really plays as. Instead I got a bunch of other currencies, icons, I think a weapon skin that was just making it purple. 

All in all I don't recommend this game. There are a million other far better games much like this that aren't trying to literally steal from you.

Not Playable.
There are extreme lag spikes that cause you to lose 5-6 seconds of time and just die.
Later in the game they create unavoidable mechanics like a bomb that you have to hot potato between players, forever.
Its a slow grind and not worth the hassle.

I did enjoy the upgrade system and the design.
The level layout and some of the bosses were fun.
Just not worth the cons.

This game has good ideas held back by terrible execution, constant lag and awful difficulty increases. The enemies in between the bosses are boring and just canon fodder and the bosses, in the higher difficulties, are hard but not for good reasons. The biggest issue in this game is the lag. Not only does it lag during runs, it lags in the menu. There is always a delay every time you try to claim a reward.

I tried to keep playing this game. Was fun. But they never fixed the stuttering. Had a bad launch with things behind paywalls. And now the hid how many ingame on the Community Hub. Signs of a sinking ship.

This game is a masterclass in how not to netcode.

If there was an award for worst online experience ever, Terminull Brigade would sweep it without competition. The netcode is beyond broken, ping spikes constantly, and when the game inevitably freezes for 2–3 seconds, you already know what’s waiting when it unfreezes: your corpse. It’s not “laggy” in the usual sense; it feels like the game is actively punishing you for daring to connect to a server.

The sad part is that underneath all this network disaster there is a fun game. But you’ll never get to enjoy it, because every firefight is decided not by skill, but by whether the netcode decides to implode that second.

Save yourself the headache. Terminull Brigade is less a co-op shooter and more a crash course in rage management.

This game I admit is a beautiful blend of "Hades" and Third person shooters, giving a PvE experience that "Overwatch" could envy. Characters are unique, modifiers make their builds engaging and the "God Boons" are all pretty viable.

However I simply can't recommend it in it's current state, its an "always online game" like "the division." resulting in tons of constant stutter where you effectively have your controller taken away while the game simply proceeds. Lost your run cause of that? oh well I guess. 

The devs have made a point its on their end but without an offline or a "peer to peer" type system its borderline unplayable until further notice, which is a shame. Hope they fix it, cause its fundamentally fun otherwise.
